pages.title: Keep a Cool Head
pages.text: Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Defeat Skor, Frostbitten Golem and Yeti, then travel to the Frosted Prison. This is world history, not proof of personal participation. Dedicated servers retain hosted encounter admission; singleplayer uses native combat. The encounter owner awards eyes and trophies.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Strange Key opens Door of Seal on the Frosted Prison route; obtain it before the sealed passage.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Cursed Tombstone must be fully charged; a weak one reports it is not ready. Interacting when ready starts its native summon stage.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Cursed Eye locates Frosted Prison. A native locator does not replace canonical JEM admission. Check its current acquisition recipe.
